verdict.rationale: Gitea exposes webhooks and a full API explicitly for building custom workflows/integrations, and real-world users confirm pairing Gitea with external CI systems like Drone for years as an alternative to native Actions. This shows the platform is commonly used with third-party CI/CD tools rather than being locked into its own pipeline system. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party documentation on integrating specific external CI/CD tools (e.g. Jenkins, CircleCI) and more than one independent corroborating source.
